steps.code:
# Let's parse the notes and build the CSV content
import csv
from io import StringIO

# Extract date from title and habit data from content
parsed_notes = []
for note in notes:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    title = note['title']
    date_str = title.replace("Habit Tracking Log for ", "").strip()
    
    # Parse content lines
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Skip the first line (header)
    habit_data = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habit_data[habit.strip()] = value.strip()
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date_str, 'data': habit_data})

# Get habit names in order from the first note (they should be consistent)
habit_names = list(parsed_notes[0]['data'].keys())
print("Habit names in order:", habit_names)

# Sort notes by date ascending
parsed_notes.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])

# Build CSV content
csv_buffer = StringIO()
csv_writer = csv.writer(csv_buffer)
csv_writer.writerow(['date'] + habit_names)
for note in parsed_notes:
    row = [note['date']] + [note['data'][habit] for habit in habit_names]
    csv_writer.writerow(row)

csv_content = csv_buffer.getvalue()
print("CSV content preview:")
print(csv_content)
